cases.sql: CREATE FUNCTION accept_int(value integer) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE AS 'SELECT allowed FROM permission'
CREATE DOMAIN held_integer AS integer CHECK (accept_int(VALUE))
CREATE FUNCTION echo(value held_integer) RETURNS held_integer LANGUAGE plpgsql AS 'BEGIN RETURN value; END'
CREATE FUNCTION defaulted(value bigint DEFAULT nextval('ticks')) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql AS 'BEGIN RETURN value; END'
CREATE FUNCTION pair(a bigint, b bigint) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql AS 'BEGIN RETURN a * 10 + b; END'
CREATE FUNCTION collect(VARIADIC items integer[]) RETURNS integer[] LANGUAGE plpgsql AS 'BEGIN RETURN items; END'
CREATE FUNCTION polymorphic(value anyelement) RETURNS anyelement LANGUAGE plpgsql AS 'BEGIN RETURN value; END'
CREATE FUNCTION replacement(value integer) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql AS 'BEGIN RETURN value + 1; END'
SELECT i, echo(i) AS value FROM generate_series(1, 3) AS t(i) ORDER BY i
SELECT i, defaulted() AS value FROM generate_series(1, 3) AS t(i) ORDER BY i
SELECT pair(b => nextval('ticks'), a => nextval('ticks')) AS value
SELECT i, polymorphic(i) AS value FROM generate_series(1, 3) AS t(i) ORDER BY i
SELECT echo(value) AS value FROM retained_value
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION replacement(value integer) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql AS 'BEGIN RETURN value + 2; END'
